{{Recipe}}

'''Lahoh''', alternately called '''laḥūḥ''' (Arabic: لحوح‎) is a griddle-cake made similar to a [[Cookbook:Pancake|pancake]], but with a slightly different texture and notable for its porous texture on one side.

== Ingredients ==
* 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Flour|white flour]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Semolina|semolina]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] instant dried [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Litre|litre]] (4¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]]) [[Cookbook:Water|water]]

== Procedure ==
# Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl.
# Add water and [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] vigorously until you get a thin batter.
# Cover bowl and let sit for 1 hour.
# Heat a [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|frying pan]] over medium heat, and lightly grease it.
# Add a ladleful of batter, and spread it out in the bottom of pan. Cook over medium heat until air bubbles form on the top of the batter.
# Remove from frying pan and let cool.
